error_reason: The WebSurfer failed to resolve conflicting information in the search results regarding the founding year (1893) and incorporation year (1914) of the NCWC. This lack of clarification led the Planner to rely on the incorrect incorporation year, propagating the error to the final answer.

hypotheses.rationale: The WebSurfer's search results contained conflicting information: the NCWC was founded in 1893 (as shown in the visible viewport) but also mentioned incorporation in 1914. The WebSurfer failed to clarify the distinction between the founding year and the incorporation year or to resolve the ambiguity through further probing. This led the Planner to rely on the incorrect incorporation year (1914) instead of the founding year (1893). Had the WebSurfer resolved this discrepancy, the correct final answer could have been reached.
